newsitem.title: UK: London tea auction saw good demand.
newsitem.headline: London tea auction saw good demand.

text.p: Good demand was noted at Monday's tea auction, but with mixed price levels, the official report said.
Bright east Africans sold well at firm to dearer levels but others showed an easier tendency. Plainer central Africans were irregular where sold.
On the offshore sector, better liquoring Kenyas and Zimbabwes met good competition at dearer rates but poorer types lost ground.
Due to the UK holiday next Monday, the next auction will be held on Monday, June 2.
